mostWorthwhile.text: Following fat from uptake through packaging and into lymph showed how its route differs from glucose and amino acids.

leastWorthwhile.text: The separate glucose and amino-acid crossings were clear but repetitive; their picture descriptions did not explain how either crosses the intestinal cell.

surprise.text: The villus had to serve as the station for both packaging and lacteal entry, although the named ingredients seemed sufficient to combine directly.

arbitrary.text: The station requirement felt somewhat arbitrary from the item names, but compatibility feedback resolved both attempts automatically.

continue.text: Yes, I would choose to continue: tracing two nutrient routes was useful, and I would be curious to see what happens after they enter circulation.
